differences.a_observable: Soft, highly diffused shadows under the yellow button.
differences.b_observable: Sharp, dark, hard-edged shadows under the yellow button.
differences.fix: Soften the shadows by increasing light source size.

differences.b_observable: Uniform lighting across the frame with bright corners.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect in post-production.

differences.a_observable: Muted, desaturated blue on the Juspay button.
differences.b_observable: Highly saturated, darker blue on the Juspay button.
differences.fix: Reduce saturation of the blue material.

differences.a_observable: Lower camera angle with more perspective tilt on the Juspay button.
differences.b_observable: Flatter, more top-down camera angle on the Juspay button.
differences.fix: Adjust camera tilt to match the reference perspective.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Soften the hard-edged shadows in B by increasing the light source size and adding diffusion.

differences.a_observable: Camera is at a low oblique angle with strong perspective distortion on the yellow button.
differences.b_observable: Camera is at a higher, flatter angle with less perspective distortion.
differences.fix: Match camera pitch and focal length to Video A.

differences.a_observable: Corners of the frame are darker than the center, showing a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: Lighting is uniform across the frame with no vignette.

differences.a_observable: The well around the blue button has a brushed metallic silver texture.
differences.b_observable: The well is a flat, dark grey matte material.
differences.fix: Apply a metallic material to the button well.

differences.a_observable: Deep ambient occlusion shadows are visible in the crevices between elements.
differences.b_observable: Crevices are brightly lit with minimal shadows.
differences.fix: Enable ambient occlusion or increase shadow depth.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Match camera angles and focal lengths to restore perspective, and add ambient occlusion and vignette.

differences.a_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is soft and diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is extremely dark and hard-edged.
differences.fix: Increase the size of the light source or adjust shadow blur settings to soften the shadow edges.

differences.a_observable: The background elements, such as the Revenue Analytics card, are heavily blurred by depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background elements are sharp and in focus, with no noticeable depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture to blur background elements.

differences.a_observable: The yellow button has a warm, golden-yellow hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow button has a highly saturated, bright lemon-yellow color.
differences.fix: Modify the diffuse color of the yellow button material to be warmer and less saturated.

differences.a_observable: The Subscriptions card is positioned on the left side of the frame, partially cut off.
differences.b_observable: The Subscriptions card is positioned near the bottom-left corner of the frame.
differences.fix: Adjust the layout and spacing of the cards on the grid to match the reference composition.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera's depth of field to introduce realistic background blur, and soften the hard-edged shadows cast by the 3D elements.

agreed_differences.a_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is soft and diffused.
agreed_differences.b_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is extremely dark and hard-edged.
agreed_differences.fix: Increase the size of the light source or adjust shadow blur settings to soften the shadow edges.

agreed_differences.a_observable: Corners of the frame are darker than the center, showing a strong vignette.

channelB.note: Clip A shows the yellow button from a lower, more dramatic oblique angle, resulting in stronger perspective distortion. Clip B shows the button from a higher, more top-down angle, which reduces the perspective distortion and makes the button appear flatter.

consolidated.highest_impact_fix: Match the camera angle and perspective to Video A, and soften the harsh shadows under the yellow button.
